steps.step: IR1 exact operator identity [H_int, psi_v] = f * X_v on a solvable pairing model: the zero mode of F commutes with H_int exactly, the commutator of the eps-mode divided by eps stays bounded and converges

IR2 exact Nambu self-energy (thermal ED, Sigma = G0^-1 - G^-1, normal and anomalous blocks): the zero-mode rows and columns of Sigma vanish identically, the eps-mode block scales like eps^2 (ratio 4 per halving) and Sigma/eps^2 stays finite (regular Sigma^)

IR4 exact spectral sum rule (no regularity assumption): int A_v = 1 and the second moment of the elementary spectral function about the free energy equals <{f X_v, (f X_v)^dag}> (spectral decomposition = operator formula) and scales like f^2 = eps^2 -> by Chebyshev the elementary weight at the light node concentrates on the free cone nonperturbatively (dark composite sectors not excluded)

IR3 (statement) for Theta_1: Sigma_int(k) = f(k)^2 Sigma^(k) in all Nambu blocks, f = |k|^2/2 + O(k^4): H_int cannot generate a mass, a constant Pauli term (node shift) or a linear velocity change at Gamma; the leading elementary limit is unconditional (IR4), the regularity of Sigma^ (no critical composite at Gamma) is needed only for the subleading analytic structure
steps.detail: leading elementary IR protected nonperturbatively; subleading structure and dark composites remain assumptions/open

steps.step: CT1 counterterms near Gamma (to linear order) allowed by C3[111] x Spin(10) x Z4 x translations: Spin(10) forces 1_16, Z4 forbids pairing, and C3 leaves a 6-dimensional space: mu, c || [111], b || [111] (node shift along [111]), and the velocity matrix in the commutant of the 120-degree rotation (a I + b' n n^T + c' [n]_x)

CT2 none of the six is generated by H_int (Sigma_int = O(k^4) at Gamma, IR3); all six may be generated by couplings acting on psi directly (dynamical gauge links) -> the Lorentz-restoration test belongs to the joint Gate B + C run
